title: WebGPU Instancing in Rust: 2,048 Asteroids with wgpu
description: Render 2,048 animated asteroids in one indexed WebGPU draw with Rust, wgpu, and WGSL. Learn per-instance buffers, texture arrays, and procedural meshes.
imageAlt: Thousands of gray, brown, and white instanced asteroids forming dense rings beneath a dark star field.
